# Developer platform blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Developer platform blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## webhooks

Outgoing webhooks: endpoints subscribed to event types, a delivery log unique per endpoint and event with leases and retries, direct dispatch, secrets in Vault with overlap while rotating, auto-disable after an endpoint keeps failing and redelivery.

- Title: Outgoing webhooks
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/webhooks
- Client: `webhooksBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/webhooks`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `updated-at`, `housekeeping`
- Works with: `permissions`, `service-accounts`, `data-lifecycle`, `housekeeping`
- Entities: `webhook_endpoint`
- Tables: `webhook_endpoints`
- Permission keys: `webhooks.manage`, `webhooks.read`
- Events (`WebhooksEvents`): `webhook_endpoint.disabled`, `webhook_endpoint.secret_rotated`

## incoming-webhooks

Per-tenant trigger URLs with a hashed token, optional Standard Webhooks or HMAC verification, a body size limit, receive counters and the last status; deliveries go to the webhook inbox with the endpoint's tenant.

- Title: Incoming webhook endpoints
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/incoming-webhooks
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `permissions`, `updated-at`, `webhook-inbox`
- Events (`IncomingWebhooksEvents`): `incoming_webhook.created`, `incoming_webhook.deleted`, `incoming_webhook.enabled_changed`, `incoming_webhook.secret_rotated`, `incoming_webhook.token_rotated`, `incoming_webhook.updated`

## api-keys

Hashed API keys for tenants and users with scopes, expiry, rotation with a grace period, a per-key rate limit and throttled last-used tracking. verify_api_key() backs apiKeyResolver; has_scope() and api_key_tenant() go in policies.

- Title: API keys
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/api-keys
- Client: `apiKeysBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/api-keys`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Entities: `api_key`
- Tables: `api_keys`
- Permission keys: `api_keys.manage`, `api_keys.own`
- Events (`ApiKeysEvents`): `api_key.created`, `api_key.revoked`, `api_key.rotated`

## credentials

Third-party tokens and API keys in Supabase Vault as bs:cred:<provider>:<name>, behind security definer credential_get, credential_set and credential_delete functions only the service role may call. vaultCredentials() in better-supabase/credentials resolves credential references through them.

- Title: Credentials in Vault
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/credentials
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Events: `credential.deleted`, `credential.updated`

## service-accounts

Non-human tenant members backed by auth.users rows that can't sign in, with roles through memberships. Organization-owned workflow versions and service webhook endpoints run as the tenant's default principal.

- Title: Service principals
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/service-accounts
- Client: `serviceAccountsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/service-accounts`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `audit`
- Events (`ServiceAccountsEvents`): `service_principal.created`, `service_principal.disabled`, `service_principal.role_changed`

## signing-keys

Ed25519 or ES256 signing keys per owner: the private JWK in Supabase Vault, one active key per owner, rotation that keeps a retired kid in the JWKS until the latest exp a signer noted, and a purge. Only the service role calls it; createSigningKeys() in better-supabase/blocks/signing-keys generates keys and signs with WebCrypto.

- Title: Signing keys
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/signing-keys
- Client: `signingKeysBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/signing-keys`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Events (`SigningKeysEvents`): `signing_key.created`, `signing_key.retired`

## security-events

OpenID Shared Signals streams: stream configuration and status per receiver, push delivery through a webhooks endpoint with format 'set' (RFC 8935), a poll queue (RFC 8936), SETs held while a stream is paused, and a receiver replay table. Only the service role calls it; createSsfTransmitter() and createSsfReceiver() in better-supabase/blocks/security-events mint and verify the SETs.

- Title: Shared signals
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/security-events
- Client: `securityEventsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/security-events`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `webhooks`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Events (`SecurityEventsEvents`): `ssf_stream.created`, `ssf_stream.deleted`, `ssf_stream.status_changed`

## oauth-server

Storage for an OAuth 2.1 authorization server: registered clients (RFC 7591) with hashed secrets, a grant per user and client, single-use authorization codes bound to a PKCE S256 challenge, device codes (RFC 8628) and a revocation list of access token jtis. It issues no tokens. createOauthServer() in better-supabase/blocks/oauth-server hashes secrets and checks PKCE, and its isRevoked plugs into accessTokenResolver.

- Title: OAuth server
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/oauth-server
- Client: `oauthServerBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/oauth-server`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Events (`OauthServerEvents`): `oauth_client.deleted`, `oauth_client.registered`, `oauth_grant.created`, `oauth_grant.revoked`

## vercel-marketplace

Vercel Marketplace provider state: installations per configuration id, provisioned resources with their tenant and secret handles, access tokens sealed in Vault, plans, invoices kept by event time and meter reports sent to Vercel per period. Only the service role calls it; createVercelMarketplace() in better-supabase/blocks/vercel-marketplace serves the Partner API, verifies webhooks, exchanges SSO codes and reports usage.

- Title: Vercel Marketplace
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/vercel-marketplace
- Client: `vercelMarketplaceBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/vercel-marketplace`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Events (`VercelMarketplaceEvents`): `marketplace_installation.created`, `marketplace_installation.deleted`, `marketplace_installation.updated`, `marketplace_invoice.status_changed`
- Env keys: `VERCEL_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID`, `VERCEL_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_SECRET`
